#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member
#endif` and "so the member is really named `private_state`"

WHY: The answer shows the macro pastes `private_` onto the member by default and expands to the plain member name when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined.
